title: #461 Ocean Exploration
prompt: Do you think that ocean exploration is as important as space exploration?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.

angles.en: Ocean research helps us understand marine life, allowing scientists to discover new species and potential sources for medicines.

plans.point2: Oceanography offers immediate benefits to global welfare because ocean currents regulate climate patterns, allowing coastal communities to better manage resources and anticipate climate shifts.
